subject: SIG follow-up: access controls & evidence for Nimbus Payments
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nimbus-payments.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security@nimbus-payments.com
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire follow-up: access controls (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Hi Vivek / Lauren,

Thanks again for walking through the SIG last week. Nimbus is moving this review to procurement this month and we need a couple of follow-ups specifically around access controls before we can close the security review. Please provide consolidated answers and evidence for the following by EOD PT today if possible:

- SSO/SAML: confirm supported SAML flows (IdP-initiated / SP-initiated), provide IdP metadata or an SP metadata snippet, and indicate whether we support signed assertions only.
- SCIM: confirm SCIM v2 provisioning support, whether we support group provisioning, and provide an audit export (past 7 days) or a sample export.
- RBAC & least privilege: describe role model, sample least-privilege role, and how changes are logged and approved.
- MFA: confirm enforcement policy for console and API access, and provide a short log excerpt (or hash) showing MFA enforcement on 2026-08-17.

Attached is the SIG Excel with our previous answers. It would help if you could return a single consolidated PDF (or Drive folder) with short answers plus config artifacts and any CSV/JSON audit extracts. If you need more time, tell me which items will be delayed and an ETA.

Attachments: SIG_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx (attached)

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Security Operations
Nimbus Payments

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nimbus-payments.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T14:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up: access controls (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA) — consolidated bundle

Hi all — attaching the consolidated answers and evidence bundle. Summary below and attachments uploaded to the Drive link Vivek shared.

Attachments included (attached to this email and in Drive):
- redwood_SIG_answers_v2.pdf (consolidated SIG answers; short, question-linked)
- scim_provisioning_diagram.png (architecture + provisioning flow)
- sso_saml_config_snippet.txt (SP metadata & example AuthnRequest/Assertion requirements)
- mfa_enforcement_log_20260817.csv (redacted timestamped enforcement events)

Short answers (high level):
- SSO / SAML:
  • SAML 2.0 supported. We support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows.
  • We require signed assertions from IdPs for authentication; we accept signed or unsigned AuthnRequests from IdPs depending on partner capability.
  • SP metadata snippet included in sso_saml_config_snippet.txt (entityID, ACS URL, certificate fingerprint).

- SCIM provisioning:
  • SCIM v2 supported (PATCH/PUT/POST/DELETE) for users and groups.
  • Group provisioning supported for group-to-role mapping; provisioning can be configured to create a membership attribute that maps to RBAC roles.
  • Export: attached mfa_enforcement_log_20260817.csv (redacted user IDs) and a 7-day SCIM audit export is in Drive as scim_audit_20260811-20260817.json (redacted).

- RBAC & least privilege:
  • Our role model is hierarchical: Organization -> Project -> Environment. Roles are scoped (admin, editor, viewer, billing).
  • Least-privilege example: "project-viewer" role grants read-only on inference endpoints and no access to billing or model rollouts.
  • Role changes require a ticket in Jira and an approval by the owning Product/Platform lead; change events are logged to our audit API and retained per policy.

- MFA enforcement:
  • MFA is required for Interactive console logins for all employee accounts and for any SSO session that requests access to the management plane.
  • API keys and service accounts do not use MFA but are governed by token rotation, IP allowlists, and scoped permissions.
  • Attached mfa_enforcement_log_20260817.csv contains enforcement events (timestamp, obfuscated_user_id, enforcement_type, result). We redact PII per our data handling policy.

If Nimbus needs the SCIM export in a specific schema or an additional signed assertion sample, say so and we can provide.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nimbus-payments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up: access controls & evidence for Nimbus Payments — quick clarification

Thanks, Marissa — this is very helpful and the bundle looks complete. Quick follow-up:

- Can you confirm whether the MFA enforcement log extract includes both web (console) and IdP-initiated SSO sessions, or is it console-only? Nimbus needs a sample that demonstrates enforcement for SSO-initiated sessions on 2026-08-17.
- If possible, provide the same log extract with user IDs hashed consistently so we can correlate events with our SAML assertion IDs (hashed).

If you can produce a second version of the CSV with consistent hashing, we can sign off on access controls and move to procurement. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Elaine
Security Operations
Nimbus Payments
